tasks.title: Collect and persist full phase check results
tasks.description: Refactor `BaseStageRunner.runChecksPhase()` so the first pass runs every check in order and persists a complete baseline result set instead of returning on the first non-pass. Keep the check interface read-only and preserve ordered execution so later orchestration can reason over one collected phase snapshot.
acceptanceCriteria: A phase with multiple failing non-approval checks records all initial check results in declared check order before any repair starts
A phase with earlier failures still runs later checks once during the baseline collection pass
Baseline check result persistence keeps complete phase evidence available to later failure handling and status reporting
No check implementation gains write, repair, or approval-request responsibilities
tasks.notes: Prefer small private helpers such as collect/classify methods so orchestration complexity stays inside BaseStageRunner rather than leaking into stage runners.

tasks.title: Resolve collected failures into repair or awaiting approval
tasks.description: Use the collected baseline results to choose the next action in `BaseStageRunner`: repair the first failed or errored non-approval check with a matching `CheckFailurePolicy`, or enter the existing approval path only when no ordinary failures remain and `user-approval` is pending. Preserve current fix-task persistence, recheck retry limits, and continue-from-repaired-check semantics for downstream checks.
acceptanceCriteria: When multiple non-approval checks fail, the runner selects the first failed or errored check with a matching policy as the repair target and records the fix task result
After a successful repair recheck passes, later checks run again from that point against the repaired state instead of being skipped permanently
If a pending user-approval result exists and no failed or errored non-approval checks remain, the stage returns awaiting approval and does not trigger repair
A pending or rejected user-approval result is never treated as a repairable check failure
If a collected failed non-approval check has no policy, the stage remains failed locally with the complete collected evidence visible
tasks.notes: Do not change stage-specific check lists or business rules in PlanStageRunner/CheckStageRunner. The new behavior should come from shared runner orchestration only.

tasks.title: Add regression coverage for collect-first check phases
tasks.description: Add focused tests around `BaseStageRunner` and existing workflow regression suites to prove the collect-first semantics end to end. Cover complete baseline visibility, pending approval without repair, explicit fix-task execution for repairable failures, and repair-then-continue behavior for downstream checks.
acceptanceCriteria: A regression test proves a phase with multiple ordinary failing checks returns complete initial check visibility instead of stopping at the first failure
A regression test proves pending user-approval yields awaiting approval without launching a fix task when no ordinary failures remain
A regression test proves a failed check with policy runs its fix task, rechecks the repaired check, and preserves later-check execution semantics
A regression test proves collected failures without policy still fail the stage with complete evidence preserved
tasks.notes: Prefer deterministic BaseStageRunner-level tests or narrow workflow regressions over broad end-to-end agent tests. Reuse existing test helpers where possible.
